<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Open a receipt"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/receipts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starts receiving an ASN: opens a receipt against a snapshot of its
lines, moves a `Registered` ASN to `Receiving` and publishes
`ReceiptOpened`. The ASN must be `Registered` or `Receiving`
(409 `asn-not-receivable`) and may have only one open receipt
(409 `receipt-already-open`). With `appointmentId` the appointment
(looked up in the local copy of dock-scheduling's) must exist
(422 `unknown-appointment`), cover the ASN (422
`asn-not-on-appointment`) and not be cancelled (409
`appointment-cancelled`); a check-in is not required (the arrival is a
yard-management fact). The receipt takes its door code from it. Without one it is a walk-in delivery with no door. A missing
ASN or appointment is 422 `unknown-asn` / `unknown-appointment`.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
